regSuccess.text: Success!  We have received your application. A confirmation email has been sent. (Check your junk/spam folder.)

regSuccessNoemail.text: Success!  We have received your application. But a confirmation email could not be sent.

maintenance.text: Currently under maintenance. Registration is down for a brief period. Thanks for being patient.

courtsReady.text: The courts are now open for booking and play! We’re excited to share that the City has installed brand new nets and net posts as part of the recent renovations. Please note that the current court lines are temporary until the new court surface is installed later this spring. The centre net straps will also be added once the new surface is completed.
